questions.question: How many customers are there?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers;

questions.answer: There are 99,441 customers in the database.

questions.question: How many customers have placed more than one order?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS multi_order_customers
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS t;

questions.answer: 0 customers have placed more than one order.

questions.question: What is the total of all payments (payment_value) for orders that contain at least one product from the 'beleza_saude' category, whatever the order status?

sql.query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.payment_value), 0) AS total_payment_value
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products pr ON pr.product_id = oi.product_id
  WHERE oi.order_id = o.order_id
    AND pr.product_category_name = 'beleza_saude'
);

questions.answer: Reading used: sum of payment_value for all orders that contain at least one product with category 'beleza_saude', regardless of order_status. Result: 1,448,729.73.

questions.question: Across all orders, what are the total freight value of the items and the total amount paid? Give both numbers.
questions.answer: Total freight value across all items: 2,251,909.54; Total amount paid: 16,008,872.12.

questions.question: How many orders include at least one product from the 'esporte_lazer' category?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders_with_esporte_lazer
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE p.product_category_name = 'esporte_lazer';

questions.answer: There are 7,720 orders that include at least one product from the "esporte_lazer" category.

questions.question: How many reviews have a score of 1?

sql.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count_reviews_score_1 FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 1;

questions.answer: There are 11,424 reviews with a review_score of 1.

questions.question: How many orders were delivered to the customer in 2017?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS delivered_orders_2017
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_delivered_customer_date < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00';

questions.answer: There were 40,930 orders delivered to customers in 2017 (counted as orders with status "delivered" and order_delivered_customer_date in 2017).

questions.question: How many orders were approved in January 2018?

sql.query:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_orders_jan_2018
FROM orders
WHERE order_status = 'approved'
  AND order_approved_at >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND order_approved_at < TIMESTAMP '2018-02-01 00:00:00';

questions.answer: There were 0 orders approved in January 2018. Reading used: counting orders with order_status = 'approved' and order_approved_at in January 2018.

questions.question: What was the total sales revenue in 2017, counting item prices only (without freight)?

sql.query:
SELECT SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue_2017
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'::timestamp
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'::timestamp;

questions.answer: The total sales revenue in 2017 (sum of item prices, excluding freight) was 6,155,806.98 BRL.

questions.question: Which product category had the highest sales revenue (sum of item prices)? Give the category and the revenue.

sql.query:
SELECT p.product_category_name, SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

questions.answer: The top category is beleza_saude, with a revenue of 1,258,681.34.
